text_block_list.text:
—The NHK Mile Cup. It happened on the day 
of that Classic-year G1 race, which Agnes 
Digital ran in last year...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, Doto-san, Trainer-san, 
there's someone I want to introduce to you 
today!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a marriage partner?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Pffft! No, I definitely won't!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
How about it? Would you care to join me at 
Tokyo Racecourse...?

And so, the four of them decided to go 
watch the race together.

And the race began, and Agnes Digital's 
fave was...
(WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes the favorite, number 4, moving 
up! Number 4 proudly takes the lead. And 
now—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Goal! A truly foreign shockwave! With her 
overwhelming presence, she bursts onto the 
scene as a prime contender to lead the 
Twinkle Series!
(Oooooooooooo!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooooh... Ooooooh...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent run. The birth of a 
new leading star. Both elegance and 
charisma, impeccable.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... they were so strong! How do I put 
it... it was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... I KNEW IT, SHE'S FINALLY 
HEREEEE!!! asdfghjkl;qwertyuiop!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, she pulled it off just as I 
expected! She's quite the hot topic among 
Umamusume fans, after all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A wide, sweeping stride. And a powerful 
kick that performs on any track surface!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Plus those adorable eyes, those long, 
slender legs! I just... I just can't take 
it anymore!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Looks like you're quite invested 
in this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I just couldn't think of her as a 
stranger. So winning this race that I ran 
in too... gosh, it makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, the Merciful Goddess within me 
is...! May I go scream my overflowing 
maternal love for a moment?!

Saying that, Agnes Digital ran right up to 
the fence—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Number fouuuur! Do your best!! Things 
might get tough from here on out, but you 
can do it! I know you can...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you're having a hard time or 
feeling lost! Your upperclassmen will be 
here to help you out!

Agnes Digital's voice, brimming with 
emotion, resonated through the air.

Indeed, Agnes Digital has also been 
through a lot since last year's NHK Mile 
Cup.

The Takarazuka Kinen. In that first clash 
between T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto, I 
was shown what true passion was—

"And the Mile Championship. Learning of 
King Halo's first-rate resolve completely 
changed my mindset as well."

And now, a new generation is born— and 
thus, the hoofprints of the Umamusume 
carry on.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So aweshum... Too bwecshus... To think I'd 
actually be allowed into such an emotional 
circle of feels...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*, *blows nose*! Every fluid in my 
body is leaking out...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! You seem quite overwhelmed with 
emotion. However, are you sure you have 
time to take things so leisurely?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you can't beat me and Doto, you won't 
be able to inspire courage in those 
following behind you either.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Far from it, if you're not careful, even 
your juniors will catch up to you. In the 
Twinkle Series, the strong are always the 
main characters, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I totally, like, get that! And 
that's why...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run a great race for my 
juniors' sake, too. I want to catch up to 
the Overlord and Doto-san. And then—!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win first, and then face her in 
a match!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"On top of winning... Whoa... she's so 
motivated..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
In that case, um, I... we'll do our best 
too~. Please take good care of us this 
autumn~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes! Likewise...!

Agnes Digital, who was once just a 
pursuer, now finds herself being pursued. 
With the cast assembled, the Twinkle 
Series has become all the more vibrant.
